### Day 131: Luke 2:21–24
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-131-luke-2-2124.html
Passage: Luke 2:21-24
Points:
- Mary and Joseph faithfully observed three Old Testament post-birth rites: circumcision, redemption, and purification.
- Jesus' physical circumcision pointed forward to the spiritual circumcision of heart that transforms believers.
- Presenting the firstborn son symbolized redemption, foreshadowing how Christ would buy believers back from sin for God.
- The offering of two birds showed Mary and Joseph's material poverty, fulfilling the law's provision for the poor.
- Jesus entered into earthly poverty so that He could become the supreme sacrifice to purify and enrich believers eternally.
